import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';
import 'package:adele_plugin_backend_support/adele_plugin_backend_support.dart';
import 'package:adele_project_storage/adele_project_storage.dart';
import 'package:diff_viewer_contract/diff_viewer_contract.dart';
import 'package:git_backend/git_backend.dart';

import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// B consumes production Git semantics only through the operation's generated
// process client. It knows no Environment root, provider implementation, or OS API.
Future<void> main(
  List<String> arguments,
  Object? bootstrapMessage,
) => runProbeBackend(arguments, bootstrapMessage, (state) {
  // Comparison-only cases retain their fixed fixture anchor. Persisted cases
  // receive no anchor at startup and read through generation-scoped infrastructure.
  final persisted = state.options['persisted'] == true;
  final configured = state.options['taskAnchor'] as Map?;
  if (persisted && configured != null) {
    throw StateError('Persisted comparisons cannot use a startup anchor.');
  }
  final taskAnchor = configured == null
      ? null
      : GitTaskComparisonAnchor(
          baselineCommit: configured['baselineCommit'] as String,
          expectedBranchRef: configured['expectedBranchRef'] as String,
        );
  final anchors = persisted
      ? GitTaskAnchorStore(
          ProjectStorageServiceClient(
            state.hostRequests.bindInfrastructure(
              hostInfrastructureContext:
                  (bootstrapMessage as Map)['hostInfrastructureContext']
                      as String,
              serviceId: projectStorageServiceId,
            ),
          ),
        )
      : null;
  return {
    'callable-shared': {
      changeSetSourceServiceId: AdeleContextualServiceDispatcher(
        hostRequests: state.hostRequests,
        createDispatcher: (operation) {
          final processes = AuthorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceClient(
            operation.bind(authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceId),
          );
          state.bufferedClients['unstaged'] = processes;
          return ChangeSetSourceServiceDispatcher(
            _Source(
              state,
              GitPortableUnstagedSnapshotService(
                processes: processes,
                taskAnchor: taskAnchor,
              ),
              anchors == null
                  ? null
                  : GitPersistedChangeSetSourceService(
                      processes: processes,
                      anchors: anchors,
                    ),
            ),
            concurrent: true,
          );
        },
      ),
      reviewApprovalHandlerServiceId: AdeleContextualServiceDispatcher(
        hostRequests: state.hostRequests,
        createDispatcher: (operation) {
          final processes = AuthorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceClient(
            operation.bind(authorizedEnvironmentBufferedProcessServiceId),
          );
          state.bufferedClients['approval'] = processes;
          return ReviewApprovalHandlerServiceDispatcher(
            _Approval(
              state,
              GitPortableReviewApprovalService(processes: processes),
            ),
            concurrent: true,
          );
        },
      ),
    },
  };
});

final class _Approval implements ReviewApprovalHandlerService {
  const _Approval(this.state, this.approvals);
  final ProbeState state;
  final ReviewApprovalHandlerService approvals;

  @override
  Future<void> approveHunk(ReviewHunkSelection selection) =>
      _invoke('approve', () => approvals.approveHunk(selection));

  @override
  Future<void> unapproveHunk(ReviewHunkSelection selection) =>
      _invoke('unapprove', () => approvals.unapproveHunk(selection));

  @override
  Future<void> approveFile(ReviewFileSelection selection) =>
      _invoke('approveFile', () => approvals.approveFile(selection));

  @override
  Future<void> unapproveFile(ReviewFileSelection selection) =>
      _invoke('unapproveFile', () => approvals.unapproveFile(selection));

  @override
  Future<void> approveAllUnstaged(ReviewLayerSelection selection) => _invoke(
    'approveAllUnstaged',
    () => approvals.approveAllUnstaged(selection),
  );

  @override
  Future<void> unapproveAllStaged(ReviewLayerSelection selection) => _invoke(
    'unapproveAllStaged',
    () => approvals.unapproveAllStaged(selection),
  );

  Future<void> _invoke(String method, Future<void> Function() invoke) async {
    try {
      await invoke();
      // The production operation has finished, including its actual index write.
      // Retirement here fences publication, not the effect, replay, or rollback.
      await state.checkpoint('after:$method');
    } on ReviewApprovalFailure catch (error) {
      state.failures.add(error.code);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:$method');
    }
  }
}

final class _Source implements ChangeSetSourceService {
  const _Source(this.state, this.snapshots, this.persisted);
  final ProbeState state;
  final GitPortableUnstagedSnapshotService snapshots;
  final ChangeSetSourceService? persisted;

  @override
  Future<ChangeSetSnapshot> snapshotUnstaged() async {
    try {
      if (persisted != null) return await persisted!.snapshotUnstaged();
      return await snapshots.snapshotUnstaged();
    } on ChangeSetFailure catch (error) {
      state.failures.add(error.code);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:unstaged');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<UncommittedChangeSetSnapshot> snapshotUncommitted() async {
    try {
      if (persisted != null) return await persisted!.snapshotUncommitted();
      return await snapshots.snapshotUncommitted();
    } on ChangeSetFailure catch (error) {
      state.failures.add(error.code);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:uncommitted');
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<TaskChangeSetSnapshot> snapshotTaskChanges() async {
    try {
      if (persisted != null) return await persisted!.snapshotTaskChanges();
      return await snapshots.snapshotTaskChanges();
    } on ChangeSetFailure catch (error) {
      state.failures.add(error.code);
      rethrow;
    } finally {
      await state.checkpoint('settled:task');
    }
  }
}
